headline: Cabinet Minister Fails Performance Review After It Is Revealed His Only Social Media Activity Is Liking Posts From His Own Secret Cat Fan Page
body: A senior cabinet member has been flagged for 'severe strategic negligence' after auditors discovered his official engagement metrics were entirely comprised of double-taps on obscure Persian Blue cat photography accounts. Government officials confirmed the minister had been using his verified state handle to maintain a streak in a private digital community dedicated to feline nutrition.
caption: When the official audit finally drops and you realize you forgot to log out of your 'CatFacts' account. 🐱💻 #Governance #CabinetReview #SocialMediaAudit #CatLovers (satire)
igHook: Tag a friend who definitely has a secret account they hope their boss never finds.
imagePrompt: A close-up of a high-end smartphone screen showing a professional government social media dashboard with colorful engagement charts next to a blurry photo of a domestic cat.

sourceHeadline.title: In Cabinet Meet, Review Of Ministers' Social Media Performance: Inside Track

judgeVerdict.reasoning: Candidate 10 succeeds by applying a human, low-stakes absurdity (secret cat fan page) to a high-stakes institutional setting, creating genuine incongruity without resorting to lazy 'politicians love social media' tropes. It avoids the AI 'slop' patterns by providing a specific, vivid mental image that feels like a real, if pathetic, human story.

safetyVerdict.reasoning: The article uses a generic 'cabinet minister' archetype without naming a specific real public figure, avoiding all personal harm or defamation risks. The satire targets universal social media habits and government bureaucratic inefficiency rather than any protected group or individual.
